full_text:
The Andaman and Nicobar Islands remain among the areas requiring particular attention, with heavy rainfall forecast at isolated places. Meanwhile, much of central, western and northeastern India is expected to experience relatively stable weather. Here is a state-wise look at the weather forecast and rain warnings for November 15.
IMD weather forecast for November 15: Key highlights
According to the IMD's latest available All India Weather Forecast Bulletin, rainfall activity is likely across parts of northwest and southern India.The key weather developments to watch are:
- Delhi-NCR and Punjab: Isolated rainfall is possible, although widespread rain is not expected.
- Himachal Pradesh: Isolated to scattered rainfall is likely in some areas.
- Uttarakhand: Isolated showers and gusty winds are possible.
- Tamil Nadu: Fairly widespread to widespread rainfall is forecast.
- Kerala: Isolated to scattered rainfall is likely.
- Andaman and Nicobar Islands: Heavy rainfall at isolated places, accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning, is expected.
- Rajasthan: Isolated thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds are possible, particularly in eastern and western parts.
Delhi-NCR weather today
Delhi and neighbouring areas, including Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram and Faridabad, may experience a change in weather conditions on Sunday. The IMD has indicated the possibility of isolated rainfall over Haryana, Chandigarh and Delhi on November 15. However, widespread rainfall is not expected across the region. Cooler conditions may continue during the morning and evening hours.Punjab weather today
Punjab may witness isolated rainfall on November 15, according to the IMD forecast. The possibility of showers comes amid changing weather conditions across parts of northwest India. However, there is no indication of widespread heavy rainfall across the state in the latest outlook.Himachal Pradesh weather today
Himachal Pradesh is likely to experience isolated to scattered rainfall on Sunday. Some areas may witness cloudy conditions and intermittent showers.The weather department has also forecast rainfall activity over the western Himalayan region, including Jammu and Kashmir and Uttarakhand. People travelling to hill destinations should check local weather and road conditions before beginning their journey, particularly in higher-altitude areas.Uttarakhand weather today
Uttarakhand may experience isolated rainfall on November 15, with gusty winds also likely at isolated places. The IMD has forecast winds reaching 30-40 kmph, with gusts reaching 50 kmph, in some areas.Tamil Nadu weather today
Tamil Nadu is likely to experience active rainfall conditions on November 15. The IMD has forecast fairly widespread to widespread rainfall over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal. Unlike northern India, where rainfall is expected to remain isolated in several areas, southern parts of the country may witness showers across a wider geographical area. Rainfall activity is also expected to continue over parts of Tamil Nadu during November 16-19.Kerala weather today
Kerala and Mahe may receive isolated to scattered rainfall on Sunday. The IMD has also forecast an increase in rainfall activity over the region in the coming days. Fairly widespread to widespread rainfall is likely over Kerala and Mahe between November 16 and 19.Andaman and Nicobar Islands weather today
The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are likely to witness some of the most active weather conditions in the country. The IMD has forecast heavy rainfall at isolated places between November 14 and 16. Thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds are also expected during the ongoing spell.Squally weather is likely over the Andaman Sea and along and off the islands, with wind speeds reaching 40-50 kmph and gusts reaching 60 kmph.Rajasthan weather today
Parts of Rajasthan may experience thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds on November 15. The IMD has indicated the possibility of isolated thunderstorms over eastern and western Rajasthan, accompanied by winds reaching 30-40 kmph and gusting up to 50 kmph. Other parts of the state are likely to remain largely dry.Weather in Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and other states
Uttar Pradesh is likely to experience mostly dry conditions, although isolated rainfall is possible in western parts of the state.Bihar is not expected to witness any significant rainfall activity on Sunday. Much of central and western India is also likely to remain largely dry.
In eastern India, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands will continue to experience an active rainfall spell. Odisha and Gangetic West Bengal are likely to see more significant rainfall activity later in the week.
Parts of northeast India are not expected to witness significant weather activity on November 15, according to the IMD's broader forecast.
Weather forecast for the coming days
Rainfall activity is expected to continue across parts of southern and eastern India over the next few days. Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal may receive further showers between November 16 and 19. Kerala and Mahe are also likely to experience fairly widespread rainfall during November 16-19.The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are expected to remain under an active rainfall spell, with heavy showers possible at isolated places during November 14-16.
Odisha and parts of West Bengal may also experience rainfall later in the week.
